content:
Morgan: quick ask — can I get a 30m admin bump to pull last weekend's prod logs for a redaction sweep? I need to extract a few traces that include user identifiers we missed in the scrub.
Jamie: what exact timeframe and services? also add why 30m vs role-based access.
Morgan: timeframe 2026-03-15 00:00-06:00 UTC. services: inference-gateway and telemetry-ingest. 30m to run `pg_dump`-style extraction + confirm redaction script output. I can stick to console session and not create creds.
Anika: pinging sec-oncall for approval. we should include the runbook link and a reviewer.
sec-oncall: @Morgan please paste the runbook snippet and the justification. default is scoped role for SSO session; no long-lived keys.
Morgan: runbook excerpt:
```
Scope: read-only logs + ephemeral console for redaction export
Commands allowed: kubectl logs -n prod gateway, s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/prod/2026-03-15/* /tmp
Prohibit: DB writes, key unwrap, user data export other than scrub bucket
```
Justification: detected 12 user identifiers in raw logs flagged by privacy-eval; need to verify scrubbed output before ticket close.
Dan: recommend Claire as reviewer, she owns the redaction rules.
Claire: happy to review. prefer copies in scrubbed bucket `s3://redwood-scrubbed/review/171400` so I can run a diff. no console writes from me either.
sec-oncall: ok logging the approval flow. @sec-bot start session request: 30m role `prod-log-reader` scoped to `inference-gateway` and `telemetry-ingest` and S3 read to `redwood-logs/*` and S3 write to `redwood-scrubbed/review/171400` only.
sec-bot: session request created: https://sessions.redwood.internal/requests/REQ-171400 — expires 2026-03-18T13:02:00Z. approvers: sec-oncall, Claire.
Jamie: small nit — please redact token-like strings before uploading to scrub bucket; you can run `sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9-_]{30,}/[REDACTED]/g'` as quick filter.
Morgan: noted. will run filter then upload. I'll post the scrub log and Claire will confirm diff.
Claire: once uploaded I'll verify and ack. keep me posted.
Dan: logging note: retention policy still applies; mark the review ticket with `access: short-bump` so infra knows to remove any temp session artifacts.
Morgan: thanks all — starting the session once sec-bot finalizes. will update here with the session link and results.
sec-oncall: approved. please follow runbook and attach the ticket id to session. :white_check_mark:
